notes.title: NEW ACHIEVEMENT + Minor DEMO Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160828/8e5d8dfb9e3f45eb4056d80346cc89afc11bc2ab.png

A bit of an update for our fellow Pilots!

ACHIEVEMENT BUG:

We were made aware of a bug in our demo achievement: BIG BALLER
This meant what was intended to be a difficult achievement to achieve became far too easy!

So, we made a fix. We renamed the old achievement to SMALL BALLER and rightfully implemented BIG BALLER as intended: Collect and HOLD 7000 hardware in a single match

How many of you can unlock this one?

Achievement Hunters, where are you at? 


MINOR DEMO UPDATE:

Some small improvements were made to the leaderboard:
- allows for visibility of longer names
- visibility of the top 100 on the global leaderboard

Where do you rank in the top 100? 
Beware, those below you might just be coming for you!


LAST CHANCE TO WIN A KEY FOR FEEDBACK:

A few hours left to submit feedback and be included in the draw for a FREE MAIN GAME KEY!

Valid entries close at 11:59 PM NZT

If you tried the demo, we would love to know how you found it.
The more feedback, the better!


Best,
The Battle Drones Team
